legacy_result.actual_question: Does a B-L shift make every support singlet satisfy 3(B-L)=0 exactly?
legacy_result.valid_interpretation: 0/24 exact shifts preserve the full continuous B-L charge on that chosen LP support.
legacy_result.invalid_interpretation: 0/24 exact shifts make the support matter-even.

correct_Z2_condition: 3(B-L) must be an integral even number; even nonzero values are allowed.

what_still_stands.sampled_search: The 60-choice-per-model search used integral-even parity and found 0 sampled matter-even D-flat hits.
what_still_stands.scope: controlled evidence, not an exhaustive proof
